passages.text: A family invites their new neighbours to tea on a rainy afternoon. “Please make yourself at home,” the host says to one visitor as she shows him a dry place for his coat. The children sit at a low table with paper and coloured pencils. Mina hopes to make friends with the child next door, but she does not begin by asking many questions. Instead, she offers a spare sheet and asks whether he would like to draw a place he enjoys. Their drawings start a relaxed conversation, and soon they are planning a picture together.

parallelText.en: A family invites their new neighbours to tea on a rainy afternoon.
parallelText.zh: 一个家庭在下雨的下午邀请新邻居来喝茶。

parallelText.en: “Please make yourself at home,” the host says to one visitor as she shows him a dry place for his coat.
parallelText.zh: 主人指给一位客人放外套的干燥地方，说：“请别拘束。”

parallelText.en: The children sit at a low table with paper and coloured pencils.
parallelText.zh: 孩子们在矮桌旁坐下，桌上有纸和彩色铅笔。

parallelText.en: Mina hopes to make friends with the child next door, but she does not begin by asking many questions.
parallelText.zh: 米娜希望和隔壁孩子交朋友，但没有一开始就问很多问题。

parallelText.en: Instead, she offers a spare sheet and asks whether he would like to draw a place he enjoys.
parallelText.zh: 她递给他一张多余的纸，问他愿不愿意画一个喜欢的地方。

parallelText.en: Their drawings start a relaxed conversation, and soon they are planning a picture together.
parallelText.zh: 画作开启轻松的交流，很快他们就开始共同设计一幅画。

passages.text: Our class discusses what it means to create a safe space for practising new skills. Everyone is invited to make a promise about how to treat classmates during practice. We agree not to make fun of someone who needs more time or makes an error. Instead, we can ask whether the person wants a hint, an example or another quiet try. Later, when a pupil struggles with a rhythm, his partner offers to tap it slowly with him. The class sees that the agreement matters most when it changes what people actually do.

parallelText.en: Our class discusses what it means to create a safe space for practising new skills.
parallelText.zh: 我们班讨论怎样为练习新技能营造安心的环境。

parallelText.en: Everyone is invited to make a promise about how to treat classmates during practice.
parallelText.zh: 每个人都被邀请就练习时怎样对待同学许下诺言。

parallelText.en: We agree not to make fun of someone who needs more time or makes an error.
parallelText.zh: 我们同意不取笑需要更多时间或犯错的人。

parallelText.en: Instead, we can ask whether the person wants a hint, an example or another quiet try.
parallelText.zh: 相反，我们可以询问对方是否需要提示、例子或一次安静的再试机会。

parallelText.en: Later, when a pupil struggles with a rhythm, his partner offers to tap it slowly with him.
parallelText.zh: 后来，一位学生掌握节奏有困难，搭档提出和他一起慢慢敲。

parallelText.en: The class sees that the agreement matters most when it changes what people actually do.
parallelText.zh: 全班看到，约定真正改变实际行动时最有意义。
